intelligence.enrichment: Moon-based festivals can shift on Gregorian dates because their dates follow lunar phases, while luni-solar calendars limit the shift by adding an intercalary month and solar sidereal festivals occur on almost the same Gregorian date each year. Calendar rule chosen for a festival -> relation to Moon phases or solar cycle -> amount of shift on the Gregorian calendar. The learner correctly applies this rule: Moon-based festivals can shift on Gregorian dates because their dates follow lunar phases, while luni-solar calendars limit the shift by adding an intercalary month and solar sidereal festivals occur on almost the same Gregorian date each year. All festivals move the same way on the Gregorian calendar, regardless of whether they use Moon phases or a solar cycle.
